__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
You see before you the greatest of the Olympians.  It seems as if he could
destroy you with a thought.  Every glance penetrates deep into your soul.
You now know what true fear is.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Zeus sits here on a throne.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle zeus god

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This mortal risked the wrath of Zeus to give the gift of fire to humans.  He
looks up at you and smiles.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Prometheus is here, playing with a match.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle prometheus

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is the messenger of the Gods.  He wears a winged helm and boots, and
darts from place to place.  He looks very busy, and it seems as if he doesn't
even notice your presence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Hermes is busy, delivering a message.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hermes

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is the brother of Zeus himself, chosen to rule the seas.  He must be
visiting Mount Olympus.  He nods at you and motions for you to enter and
have a seat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Poseidon is dining here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle poseidon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This jovial God is strumming on a lyre.  He smiles at you and asks you to
join him.  You notice a dangerous looking bow by his side, however, and think
that he knows more than music.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Apollo is here, playing a tune.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle apollo

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The God of War is here, studying some maps.  He scowls at you as you enter
and says 'I am very busy.  What do you want?'
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Ares is here, kicking your ass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ares

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Zeus' favorite daughter is sitting on a couch eating grapes.  She smiles at
you and invites you to join her.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Athena is relaxing here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle athena

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This God is the only one who is not physically perfect.  He is lame and very
ugly.  You get the impression that he is kind, however, and would go out of his
way to help you.  He is attended by three golden maidens.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Hephaestus the Smith is here, crafting a fine weapon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hephaestus smith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you gaze upon this creation, you realize that she is made from solid
gold.  She seems to be very lifelike as she assists the smith in his work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Handmaid of gold is here, assisting the smith.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle handmaid golden

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This man is waiting on Ares.  Although he does not look very strong, you
realize that Ares would not have any weaklings working for him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A soldier is here, assisting Ares.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle soldier

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This man has mastered his first profession, and is now studying music from the
immortal Apollo.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A musician is here, learning from Apollo.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle musician apprentice

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This boy is truly lucky to be able to serve Athena herself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A servant is here, feeding Athena her grapes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle boy serving servant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This great beast can barely be called a dog.  It has been bred to cause fear
on the battle field, and you have no doubt that it does its job well.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large hound snarls at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hound dog war

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you gaze at Odin, you realize how insignificant you truly are.  He towers
over you, and is so intent on his activities that he barely recognizes your
presence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Odin is resting here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle odin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This jovial man has devoted his life to selling fruit and other foods to the
inhabitants of this city.  Although he may seem like a wimp, it would be wise
not to underestimate him.  He smiles warmly at you and shows you his selection
of delicious looking foods.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Julius the Green Grocer stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle grocer greengrocer julius

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Skilled in all manner of magic, as well as the ancient art of alchemy, he
stands ready to supply the citizens here (but not you) with all manner of
arcane supplies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The ancient, wizened Alchemist stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle alchemist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Clive looks VERY big and VERY tough.  All those years in the army must have
paid off.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Clive the Weapons Master is practicing with his bow and axe.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle clive

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Samuel looks just like Clive the Weapons Master: VERY big and VERY tough.
He doesn't like what you've been doing in his city.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Samuel the Armourer glares at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle armourer samuel

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Ra is very bright!  It hurts your eyes to look at him, so you can tell little
about his appearance.  What you can tell, however, suggests that he is no one
to be trifled with.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Ra the Egyptian Sun God is resting here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ra sun god

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This bizarre creature has three heads - one of a goat, one of a lion, and one
of a dragon.  It growls at you as you enter the cell, then suddenly attacks!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A chimera prowls the cell.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chimera

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Hera, the wife of Zeus is here.  She smiles at you as you enter and invites you
to rest and sit for a while.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Hera is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hera

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This is a giant bird.  It looks at you quizzically, then makes a noise and
looks away.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A roc is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle roc

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks happy and carefree.  He smiles and tips his hat to you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A citizen of this town is strolling down the street here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle citizen resident

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This horse is snow white with large wings.  Although it doesn't look very
threatening, it seems as though it would be dangerous if provoked.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large horse with wings is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pegasus horse

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This man looks as is he has been spending WAY too much time in the kitchen.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cook is here, hard at work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cook

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks as though he has spent a lot of time underground, guarding the
prisoners.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The jailer is here, watching for intruders.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jailer
